conditions.angularOrigin: specified inertial origin; also report intrinsic COM angular momentum
conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

conventions.massQuantiles: inverse empirical mass CDF; no rank interpolation
conventions.potential: not evaluated; provide current specificPotential explicitly
conventions.virial: W_ij = sum m r_i a_j from caller supplied current field; surface terms not estimated
conventions.overflowBins: upper=null includes all radii above the last edge; density is undefined there
conventions.cylindricalAxis: R=0 particles omitted from cylindrical velocity moments only

plane.method: 6-step Huber IRLS PCA, 2.5 MAD-normal scales; geometric median center; spherical fit aperture; signed-height median intercept
